name: n8n

pricingTiers.name: Starter
pricingTiers.note: €24/mo monthly, or €20/mo billed annually (EUR, not USD)

bestFor: Developers who want Zapier-like workflows with less vendor lock and more code
skipIf: You need the largest catalog of one-click consumer apps and zero ops
keyFeatures: Visual workflow builder with real JS/Python code nodes
Built-in AI agent and LLM tool nodes
limitations: Smaller one-click consumer app catalog than Zapier
Requires basic ops/debugging comfort when self-hosted
summary: The automation tool we actually self-host. Fair-code, execution-priced cloud, and a real code node.
body: n8n is how you keep Zapier’s idea without renting every execution at consumer SaaS rates. Self-hosting the Community Edition is free for a lot of us, while n8n Cloud is billed in EUR by workflow executions (Starter €24/mo monthly or €20/mo annual). Agents and AI nodes exist; they are not a reason to ignore error handling. If you outgrow Make or Zapier on cost, start here before writing a custom worker.
notes: Self-hosting on a modest VPS or private server keeps operational costs predictable as workflows grow.
Log failures. Silent workflows destroy trust.
Not a “set and forget wealth” toy
